methods.median: median of all five per-seed metric values; no seed excluded
methods.welch: two-sided independent-samples Welch t-test on per-seed outcomes; same seed labels are retained but pairing is not used
methods.holm: Holm adjustment within each family × metric, separately for RQ1 test and RQ3 holdout
methods.rq1_pairs: HiPaG_full vs each of shallow, graphmeta, Bi-LSTM, Flat GATv2, CodeBERT on test PR-AUC and FPR@TPR95
methods.rq3_pairs: HiPaG_full vs each baseline plus Flat GATv2 vs CodeBERT on holdout PR-AUC and precision@1% prevalence
methods.low_pr_auc_claim: checked separately for test and holdout using the mean over the five saved seeds
methods.lowest_pr_auc_claim: Checked among the six detectors in the saved RQ1 outputs, separately by split using mean PR-AUC over five seeds; also counted per-seed minima. Does not assert lowest among baselines not present in the saved summary.
